results.name: Vintage red 3D interface has no reader, chapter rail or skip controls
Opening keeps 3D visible and book occupies the reading area
Clicking a printed page keeps the 3D book and cannot jump chapters
Closing from the middle folds all sheets within the hardcover
Sequential reading reaches the final page; reopening always starts at the beginning
3D zoom enlarges the actual mesh and reset restores framing
390px mobile stays in 3D, reads editorial pages sequentially and closes cleanly
No uncaught JavaScript errors in revised reading flow

limits: Chrome headless only; real Android/iOS not tested
Mesh geometry and animation frames checked; no claim of physically exact paper simulation
